question: Nowruz is popularly known as the new year of which religious group / community?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Parsi**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• **Parsi:**

 
 
• Nowruz, also spelled as Navroz or Noruz, is the Parsi New Year.
 
• It is a significant festival for the Parsi community, who are followers of Zoroastrianism.
 
• Nowruz is celebrated on the spring equinox, usually around March 21st.
 
• It marks the first day of the Farvardin, the first month of the Zoroastrian calendar.
 
• Nowruz is a time for renewal, reflection, and celebration.
 
• It is a secular holiday with roots in ancient Persian traditions.
 
• The celebrations often include special prayers, feasts, and gatherings with family and friends.
 
• Traditional Parsi dishes and sweets are prepared for the occasion.
 
• New clothes are often worn, and homes are decorated.
 
• Nowruz is a symbol of hope and new beginnings.
 
• It is a time to reflect on the past year and look forward to the new year.
 
• The festivities often last for several days.
 
• The observance of Nowruz varies slightly among different Zoroastrian communities.
 
• It is a joyous occasion marked by cultural performances and festive events.
 
 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Buddhism:**

 
 
• Buddhism has its own calendar and festivals, but Nowruz is not one of them.
 
• Buddhist New Year celebrations vary depending on the specific Buddhist tradition.
 
• They often involve religious observances and practices.
 
 
 
• **Sikhism:**
 
 
• Sikhs have their own distinct calendar and celebrate Vaisakhi as their New Year, which typically falls in April.
 
• Nowruz is not a Sikh festival.
 
 
 
• **Muslim:**
 
 
• The Islamic calendar is a lunar calendar, and the Muslim New Year is celebrated on the first day of Muharram.
 
• It is a solemn occasion, not typically associated with the spring equinox.
 
• Nowruz is not a Muslim festival. Although some Muslim-majority countries like Iran, Afghanistan, and parts of Central Asia celebrate Nowruz as a cultural and secular holiday.
